name: rfq-to-quote
title: RFQ to Quote
audience: B2B sales operations team or distributor
summary: Turn a buyer's request for quotation into a draft commercial quote using an approved catalog, price list, and supplied commercial rules.
free_result: Matched quote line items, source prices and calculations, a customer-ready draft, and a missing-information list. Ask for clarification on uncertain matches or terms; never invent a discount or delivery promise.
differentiator: Specialize in catalog-based B2B quoting with traceable line items and exception handling. A generic proposal writer is already widely available.
service_bridge: Custom quote automation, CRM/ERP integration, pricing-rule interfaces, and approval workflows.
paid_moment: Can this use customer-specific pricing, availability, approvals, and our CRM or ERP?
website_title: Generate Quotes from RFQs and Price Lists - Free AI Skill
primary_query: AI quote generation from price list
